div.div:
Total cost: one table · one nightly job · one dashboard · one page ≈ 10 dev-days.
Cheaper than any feature it governs — and it upgrades every plan in all three folders from a CLAIM to a MEASUREMENT.
The slide that wins: "personalization — effect not yet distinguishable from zero at this volume; here is the minimum detectable effect and when we will know."
Judges trust the deck MORE after that slide, not less.
